name: Fuwa Kazuya
source:
The hero of this game. Kazuya is laid-back and a little lazy, going through life with no particular goal in mind. But when his childhood friend Amane is attacked by mysterious creatures known as "Evolutions," Kazuya jumps in to save her, and so finds himself caught up in a secret war..

(from Hirameki)
